indicator_rule: Indicators meet Gentry's test. Lists stay flat, not tiered by time (Grabo). Readouts count changed indicators per hypothesis; there is no weighted threat score. An indicator hit from the charters counts once two independent sources report it (two-source rule); a single-source hit is shown as claimed and moves nothing.
emerging_concerns: A country on a Rising list outside every zone goes to the review queue (the Rising list on the site). It is proposed as a new zone after it recurs in 3 separate weeks (precedent: the Ethiopia & Eritrea split of 27 Oct 2026) and dropped from the queue after 60 quiet days.

indicators.text: News attention to the zone or topic is well above its own normal
indicators.rule: headline-filtered stories, log-scale z >= 2 against the entity's previous 28 complete days, weekday-adjusted, and >= 5 stories; never on a partial day

indicators.text: Violent events placed in the zone are well above the zone's normal
indicators.rule: articles with an assault, fight or mass-violence event (CAMEO 18-20) placed in the zone and a headline naming the zone; z >= 2 against the previous 28 complete days and >= 5 articles
indicators.baseline: previous 28 complete days (rolling); 90-day median shown beside it

indicators.text: Violence in a zone country has stayed well above its 90-day normal
A zone country is rising on violence
indicators.rule: country z >= 2.5 against its previous 28 complete days, >= 1.5x expected, >= 15 articles

indicators.text: A zone country is rising on news attention
indicators.rule: country z >= 2.5 against its previous 28 complete days, >= 1.5x expected, >= 40 articles

indicators.series: countries.json files and partial; feed health
indicators.rule: partial day, or fewer than 90% of the day's 192 GDELT Events files (96 per stream)
